# Incident clock consolidation

`customer_support.pb.sla_management.incident_clock_consolidation` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> When one cause is breaching many clocks, manage the clocks as a set: one status of record, one restoration commitment, per-ticket updates that all point at it.

Treating a shared cause as many independent clocks multiplies the communication load exactly when capacity is lowest, and produces contradictory promises across tickets that customers compare with each other.
